Bind PostgreSQL postimages to namespace, store identity, admission lifetime and the existing write receipts while preserving authority, rollback and unknown-outcome checks. PostgreSQL warm-window requests fall from 59.9 to 17.3 in the owner census. Three alternating SQLite measurement pairs retain identical causal SQL and request counts. Exact-head CI and PostgreSQL owner review passed.

items.title: fix(test): prevent TSX cache file descriptor bursts
items.summary: fix(test): prevent TSX cache file descriptor bursts Disable TSX disk writes before owned test loaders start. Synchronous imports can queue hundreds of unawaited cache writes; retain TSX's in-memory cache and Vitest's separate transform cache. Keep delayed handoff gates attached to their operation and test lifetime so an early startup error is reported instead of hidden by a timeout. Preserve every handoff assertion and deadline. Proof: Linux original policy reached 500 open descriptors at a 512 cap; the wrapper-only repair passed all 23 unchanged cases three times, with 27-89 descriptors sampled at case starts (476.81s wrapper wall). Final macOS handoff file: 23 passed in 169.34s wall. Cache/runner regressions, targeted types/lint and independent P2 review passed.

items.title: fix(update): verify readiness after authentication rejection (#175735)
items.summary: fix(update): verify readiness after authentication rejection (#175735) After a 2026.10.2 -> 2026.10.4 update, post-restart verification connected without a device identity, the new Gateway rejected it with 1008 'device identity required', and the verifier kept retrying for the full 30-minute health window before recording a failure even though the Gateway was healthy. Deterministic authentication refusals now end the retry loop immediately; the verifier then confirms the expected version/build and readiness through the Gateway's local HTTP startup/readiness endpoints and records success with an authentication warning. Gateway admission and pairing are unchanged; an unready or mismatched Gateway still fails verification. Fixes #175712

items.title: fix(whatsapp): final replies disappear after unrelated reloads
items.summary: fix(whatsapp): final replies disappear after unrelated reloads Fix WhatsApp final replies being discarded when unrelated configuration or plugin settings reload during a turn, including accounts with their own settings. Retain the original Gateway configuration with the admitted channel registration and compare its relevant channel/default/plugin settings with the current configuration. Prepare the selected WhatsApp account from current configuration for final delivery through the existing account resolver, preserving reply prefixes, chunking, and current global policy. Validation: focused monitor, dispatch, and shared durable-delivery regressions cover unrelated reloads, account overrides, relevant-change rejection, and lifecycle/sender guards. Exact-head CI passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39051587992 Live WhatsApp transport delivery was not tested.
